description: This file defines the DocumentsViewDetail class, which extends ViewDetail to handle the presentation of document detail views in a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for generating module title parameters and displaying document details, with specific handling for missing file errors.

classes.name: DocumentsViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to manage the display of document details within the SuiteCRM module.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for the module title, including the document name.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to check if the file is missing and display an error if so, then proceeds with the standard display.
